'''Café Tatoo II''' was located in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], near the [[Twin Shadows Inn]]. It was named after [[Tatoo II/Legends|Tatoo II]], a [[Binary star/Legends|binary star]] in the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]]. The café had an awning-shaded balcony overlooking the [[Kerner Plaza]]. One of its [[Waiter/Legends|waiters]] was [[GG-8]], a [[GG-series hospitality droid]] who, by [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], had been working there for years. [[Annileen Calwell]] discovered the café with her [[Marriage/Legends|husband]], [[Dannar Calwell|Dannar]], and frequently visited it during her trips to Mos Eisley. In 19 BBY, she visited the café with her new friend, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Ben Kenobi]].<ref name="Kenobi" />
